steps.title: Define requirements and structural design for Notes Master
steps.description: Determine note fields (title, content, category, and timestamps), configure standard UI layouts, and organize assets.

steps.title: Create configuration file app-meta.json
steps.description: Store project meta indicators including package name and application name at the root of the workspace.

steps.title: Generate high-compatibility Gradle scripts for AGP 8.3.2
steps.description: Configure compilation metrics pointing to compile/target SDK 34, JDK 1.8 compatibility, and specify build tools and application parameters.

steps.title: Declare manifest application metadata and entry point in AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Setup app configurations, request system permissions if needed, register MainActivity as launcher, and configure default Light Material styling.

steps.title: Create shape drawables for UI element layout styling
steps.description: Create custom shapes for the floating action button, individual notes background cards, and category tag highlight labels.

steps.title: Design main application window layout in activity_main.xml
steps.description: Set up the master view layout containing search inputs, category selection filters, list views, empty states, and add actions.

steps.title: Design note list item view row representation in note_item.xml
steps.description: Assemble labels for representing title strings, description text, timestamp records, and category chips.

steps.title: Develop structured data manager inside DatabaseHelper.java
steps.description: Write standard SQLite open instructions allowing localized insert, retrieve, update, and delete actions for notes items.

steps.title: Develop primary state controllers inside MainActivity.java
steps.description: Link application views, configure input search and dynamic drop-down filter event callbacks, and read SQLite records.

steps.title: Build dynamic UI Adapter rendering mapped database objects into lists
steps.description: Construct standard BaseAdapter implementation binding Note fields into specialized visual note list elements dynamically.

steps.title: Build customized dialogue alert boxes for note modification flows
steps.description: Implement standard modal alerts with dynamic content fields enabling user creation and note modifications directly.

steps.title: Perform visual quality assurance and execution flow testing
steps.description: Double-check layout XML rendering, search-term matching logic, categorization filtering state, and UI response behavior.

steps.title: Building Notes Master
steps.description: Execute native build routines via Gradle assemble tasks to build the APK package for debug testing.
